scope:
Gate: native-21 must sit in a pose a real board can take (R31).

R4-R30 placed the board with x_w = 141 - x_k on KiCad coordinates, a mirror image (determinant -1)
nobody noticed for 14 revisions. This check places the stage-13 STEP by a proper transform only - the
translation x_w = X - 141, y_w = 236 + Y, z_w = 26 + Z (STEP Y = -y_k) - and requires the saved
native-21 board and component solids to match it: same solid count (after the 2.5 mm lead trim)
and every saved solid's bounding box within 0.05 mm of a properly placed one.
